title: From Shots to Rallies to Sets: Hierarchy-Aligned Multi-Task Learning for Next-Shot Prediction in Racket Sports
abstract: arXiv:2611.15529v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Next-shot prediction in racket sports requires learning from event data with different match structures, recorded attributes, and label vocabularies. Table tennis, badminton, and tennis nevertheless share a hierarchy in which shots form rallies and rallies form higher scoring units. We present MT-HTA, a hierarchy-aligned multi-task Transformer that uses this structure to jointly predict the attributes of the next shot. A hierarchical temporal Transformer captures event progression at each level of the hierarchy, a feature-token path models interactions among semantic fields rather than along the time axis, and task-specific attention retrieves information from hierarchical summaries and player context. The architecture supports three- and four-level hierarchies and sport-dependent task sets. Across four datasets from three sports, the final MT-HTA achieves the highest mean task-averaged F1 among the compared main models. Ablations on

translated_title: 从击球到回合再到局：面向球拍运动下一击预测的层级对齐多任务学习
translated_abstract: 球拍运动中的下一击预测需要从具有不同比赛结构、记录属性和标签词表的事件数据中学习。尽管如此，乒乓球、羽毛球和网球仍然共享一个层级结构：击球构成回合，回合构成更高层的得分单元。我们提出了MT-HTA，一个层级对齐的多任务Transformer，利用这一结构来联合预测下一击的各项属性。层级时间Transformer捕捉层级中每一级别的事件进展，特征令牌路径建模语义字段之间的交互而非沿时间轴的交互，任务特定的注意力机制则从层级摘要和球员上下文中检索信息。该架构支持三级和四级层级结构以及依赖于具体运动项目的任务集合。在来自三个运动项目的四个数据集上，最终的MT-HTA在所有对比的主要模型中取得了最高的平均任务F1值。
tldr: 该论文提出MT-HTA，一种利用乒乓球、羽毛球和网球共有的“击球-回合-局”层级结构的层级对齐多任务Transformer，能够联合预测下一击属性，并在三个运动项目的四个数据集上取得最高的平均任务F1值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MT-HTA, a hierarchy-aligned multi-task Transformer that leverages the shared shot-rally-scoring-unit hierarchy across table tennis, badminton, and tennis to jointly predict next-shot attributes, achieving the highest mean task-averaged F1 across four datasets from three sports.
